en.title: Max Valid Expression in Puzzle Matrix
en.description:
An expression starts at any digit cell and can only go straight right or straight down, without turning. The characters must alternate as digit, +/-, digit; a single digit is also a valid expression. Find the maximum value of a valid path expression.

The problem semantics follow the fixed OAMaster snapshot; the input protocol and limits supplemented by this site are defined by this site.
en.input: h,w (1..100, hw≤10000); the character matrix contains only digits, +, and −, with at least one digit. The size limits are site supplements.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the full approach, proof, and complexity.
